title: Meta is testing Direct, a standalone messaging app for Instagram that doesn't require an existing Instagram account to use, in Thailand and Turkey (Karissa Bell/Engadget)
summary: Karissa Bell / Engadget: Meta is testing Direct, a standalone messaging app for Instagram that doesn't require an existing Instagram account to use, in Thailand and Turkey — It's only available in Turkey and Thailand for now. — Meta is working on a dedicated messaging app for Instagram that could also expand the reach of the app's DMs.
